import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();ids=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);queue=sys.argv[2]
worker=json.loads((root/'runs'/queue/'worker.json').read_text())
assert worker['hostname']==socket.gethostname()
hz=os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK');page=os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE')
uptime=float(pathlib.Path('/proc/uptime').read_text().split()[0])
for ident in ids:
 p=root/'runs/tasks'/ident;s=json.loads((p/'status.json').read_text())
 assert s['hostname']==socket.gethostname() and s['pbs_job']==worker['pbs_job']
 if s['status']!='running':
  print(json.dumps(dict(task=ident,status=s['status'],observed=time.time())));continue
 launcher=pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(s['pid'])
 assert launcher.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
 argv=(launcher/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0');argv=[x.decode() for x in argv if x]
 assert argv[-len(s['command']):]==s['command']
 stat=(launcher/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
 assert int(stat[2])==s['pid']
 todo=[s['pid']];seen=set();rows=[]
 while todo:
  pid=todo.pop()
  if pid in seen:continue
  seen.add(pid);q=pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(pid)
  try:
   assert q.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
   st=(q/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
   assert int(st[2])==s['pid']
   args=[x.decode() for x in (q/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if x]
   rows.append(dict(pid=pid,ppid=int(st[1]),comm=(q/'comm').read_text().strip(),state=st[0],argv=args,cpu_seconds=(int(st[11])+int(st[12]))/hz,rss_mib=int(st[21])*page/1048576,process_elapsed_seconds=uptime-int(st[19])/hz))
   children=subprocess.run(['ps','-o','pid=','--ppid',str(pid)],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,universal_newlines=True)
   assert children.returncode in (0,1)
   todo.extend(int(x) for x in children.stdout.split())
  except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):pass
 stages=[x for x in (p/'stdout.log').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('AFS_STAGE ')]
 print(json.dumps(dict(task=ident,host=socket.gethostname(),pbs_job=s['pbs_job'],observed=time.time(),task_elapsed_seconds=time.time()-s['started'],last_stage=stages[-1] if stages else None,processes=rows,scope='known task descendants only; current RSS, not peak RSS; no environment read')),flush=True)
